d: Accommodated room for the proof of a work. Petronilla, Luigino, Angiolina, Rosina, Claudio, all to sit with music card in hand; Ptolemy sitting apart.
Petronilla, Luigino, Angiolina, Rosina and Claudio.
Room in the hotel in Lorano. Lorano and a Servant.
Angiolina's room with harpsichord. Angiolina and Claudio, both with music card in hand.
Angiolina, then Rosina and Luigino with music cards in hand.
Common room. Petronilla at a small table, which writes. Angiolina That gets her head adjusted by the Hairdresser. Rosina to sit in grub. Luigino to sit not far from Rosina, mortified.
Room. Petronilla, Luigino, Angiolina, Rosina and Claudio.
A Servant, then Rosina, then Angiolina, then Luigino.
Another room. Petronilla, Rosina, Luigino and Claudio.
